packageRules.description: Eagerly bump internal Flagsmith packages on every release

Hold back automated Python updates until a release has been public for a week. This complements exclude-newer in pyproject.toml, which is what covers transitive dependencies and lock file maintenance; Renovate passes no cutoff to uv.

Leave the npm cooldown to npm itself, via min-release-age in .npmrc. Renovate passes a single global --before to npm and cannot express our @flagsmith exclusion; when that cutoff makes npm fail with ETARGET it retries without any cutoff, dropping the cooldown for every package in that lock file update. npm applies the same policy with the exclusion honoured, so let it own this.

Exempt internal Flagsmith packages from the cooldown, so we can publish one and consume it immediately. Listed individually because they share no common prefix; keep in sync with exclude-newer-package in api/pyproject.toml. The npm equivalent lives in frontend/.npmrc.
Re-enable lock file maintenance, which security:only-security-updates disables. Keep last with an empty scope to ensure commit scope is applied correctly.
